articles.summary: ORLANDO, Fla. — June 10, 2026 — VirTra, Inc. (Nasdaq: VTSI) (“VirTra” or the “Company”), a global provider of judgmental use of force training simulators and firearms training simulators for the law enforcement and military markets, today announced the purchase of its Orlando building along with a neighboring property, reinforcing the Company’s long-term commitment to Central Florida […]
articles.title: VirTra Expands Orlando Presence with Purchase of Dual-Building Campus
